verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase let developers define serverless functions that automatically fire in response to Firestore/Auth/Storage background events, HTTPS requests, or Cloud Scheduler jobs — directly matching the 'rules that trigger actions on events' story, and this is corroborated by multiple first-party doc excerpts (firebase-docs-7, firebase-docs-8, firebase-docs-17).  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that triggers fire reliably in production, and no evidence of an AI-native natural-language rule-authoring interface for these triggers (only generic MCP/CLI access is documented).
